hook: Your planet once crashed a spacecraft into an asteroid on purpose.
title: NASA Crashed Into an Asteroid and Moved It
description:
In 2022 NASA's DART spacecraft hit the asteroid Dimorphos on purpose. It shortened the little moon's orbit around Didymos by about 32 minutes. It was the first time humans changed the motion of a space object.

#Shorts #Space #NASA
comment_prompt: Should we move more asteroids? Yes or no
